test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In a code language, ‘OCEAN’ is written as ‘SGIER’ and ‘FISH’ is written as ‘JMWL’.

How will ‘RIVER’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:

OCEAN is written as SGIER

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb4db1158ca56afcebb9c62ef6b42ebd94fe69dde35cf3737b2addbb6b1ded48.png] 

FISH is written as JMWL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c06797cf267dd7d0f1b709b6e01d39f5d060d843178c37e0e3c23e8c938903d6.png] 

Similarly, RIVER is written as VMZIV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3ff971d5faf415d7283b1df48cd717251926e14bfe3ec16c0ebb8be6d87941a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is __**VMZIV**__.
